items.statement: The submission explores plausible pair orientations without presupposing a mechanism and retains candidate identity through advancement/exclusion.
items.expected: Search/validation records identify explored candidates, selection criterion and stopping rule.

items.statement: The selected optimized structure is validated as a stationary minimum and monomer/dimer thermochemistry uses a consistent convention.
items.expected: Frequency or justified alternative evidence supports a minimum and the three energy terms are traceable.

items.statement: The methyl-capped IIPO-oIPP pair has an attractive gas-phase interaction enthalpy.
items.expected: Reported ΔH is approximately −10.675 kcal/mol (−44.66 kJ/mol), subject to a fair method/conformer tolerance.

items.statement: Any scientific conclusion is bounded by the methyl-capped gas-phase model and must report geometry diagnostics.
items.expected: Report includes cap-carbon distance/planarity and avoids claiming direct duplex thermodynamics.
